project_requirements.title: What the call wants
project_requirements.question: What must the project address, develop and achieve?

cards.title: Problem and user
cards.question: Which problem or need must the project address, and whose need is it?

cards.title: Scope
cards.question: Which activities and subjects are in scope, which are required, and which are excluded?

cards.title: Deliverables
cards.question: What must the project develop and deliver?

cards.title: Maturity
cards.question: What TRL is expected at the start and end of the project, and which stages are allowed (research, prototype, demonstration, deployment)?

cards.title: Expected impact
cards.question: Which outcomes and policy goals must the project contribute to?

cards.title: Composition
cards.question: How many partners, of which types (including end users) and from which countries? Are there rules on how the budget is split?

cards.title: Leadership
cards.question: Who may or must coordinate or hold a leadership role?

project_requirements.title: TenneT's position
project_requirements.question: What is TenneT's position within the consortium?

cards.title: Participation route
cards.question: Can TenneT apply, coordinate, join as a partner, or take part without funding?

cards.title: Funding for TenneT
cards.question: Can TenneT receive funding, at what rate, and under which national rules?

cards.title: TenneT's likely contribution
cards.question: What could TenneT credibly bring to the project?

project_requirements.title: Setting
project_requirements.question: In which environment must the project take place?

cards.title: Test environment
cards.question: Where and under what conditions must the solution be tested (lab, simulation, real site, live infrastructure), and in which country or region?

cards.title: Data, IP and security
cards.question: Does the call impose open-data, IP or security obligations that TenneT would have to accept?

project_requirements.title: After the project
project_requirements.question: How must the project scale, replicate or achieve uptake?

cards.title: Uptake
cards.question: What must happen with the result: replication, standards, an implementation model, dissemination, use after funding ends?

funding_timing_submission.title: Funding
funding_timing_submission.question: How much funding can the project receive?

funding_timing_submission.title: Timing
funding_timing_submission.question: What timing should the proposal submission and project follow?

funding_timing_submission.title: Application
funding_timing_submission.question: Mandatory information to include in the application

cards.title: Evaluation and selection — scored or ranked
